misses.reason: Measured 282M vs band max 60M on dev (M3a review long arm): without famine variance, harvest failure, plagues, or exhausted soil, intrinsic growth runs toward farmed capacity, and the share-keyed regime reaches the matured farmed capacity within a few centuries of arrival. M3b mortality and intensification physics own this miss; no rate is dialed.
Measured 1.27B vs band max 100M on dev: the same missing-mortality physics as population:-5000.

Measured above 2B vs band max 400M on dev: the curve saturates against farmed capacity (Malthus via ceiling only, no famine variance), the same missing-mortality physics as population:-5000.

Measured -4790 vs latest -6000 (-5200 with the ±800 grace) on dev. The front runs at the measured 0.85 km/yr (Levant to Balkans) and 1.05 km/yr (Balkans to Rhine), inside the radiocarbon band, from a Levant ignition at -8050 whose hearth cell reaches half farmed at -7570; the real dates need domestication about a millennium earlier than the lag-from-Younger-Dryas law gives and the Anatolian/Aegean maritime leapfrog that the 40 km hop cannot make (P14, long sea voyages). A physics finding, not a dial.

Measured -6280 vs earliest -3500 (-4300 with the grace) on dev. Sorghum ignites on its own across Africa at -6800: its range box spans the whole Sahel and its domestication lag runs from the Younger Dryas peopling, so the peopled-basin law fires two thousand years after the opening. The real delay is the Holocene humid period's population history (P10, owner ruling pending) and the range/lag data (DECISIONS 26, review ruling g); neither is a rate to dial.
